name: Hummus
description: A creamy dip made from chickpeas, perfect as a spread or side.
instruction: Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil until smooth. Season with salt.

name: Soy Beef Soup
description: A hearty soup made with soy protein and vegetables.
instruction: Simmer soy protein with vegetables and seasonings in broth until tender.

name: Tofu Broccoli Stew
description: A comforting stew of tofu and broccoli in a savory broth.
instruction: Simmer tofu and broccoli in a broth of soy sauce, garlic, and ginger.

name: Noodle Wok
description: Stir-fried noodles with vegetables in a savory sauce.
instruction: Stir-fry vegetables and noodles, then add soy sauce, sesame oil, and seasonings.

name: Tofu and Chanterelle Ramen
description: A rich and creamy stew made with a variety of mushrooms.
instruction: Cook mushrooms with onions and garlic, then add vegetable broth and seasonings.

name: Chicken with Potato
description: Tender chicken served with roasted potatoes.
instruction: Roast chicken and potatoes with herbs until golden and cooked through.

name: Chicken with Penne Pasta
description: Juicy chicken paired with penne pasta in a creamy sauce.
instruction: Cook chicken and pasta, then combine with a creamy sauce of your choice.

name: Sausage with Meatballs
description: Savory sausages and meatballs served with your choice of side.
instruction: Fry sausages and meatballs until golden and cooked through.

name: Egg and Avocado Toast
description: A simple and healthy breakfast of avocado on toast.
instruction: Mash avocado and spread on toasted bread. Top with seasoning or toppings of choice.

name: Pasta Bolognese
description: A rich and hearty meat sauce served with pasta.
instruction: Cook ground meat with tomatoes and seasonings, then serve over pasta.

name: Chickpea Bento
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan. Add drained chickpeas and season with cumin, paprika, and salt. Cook for 10 minutes until golden and fragrant. Serve warm or cold with rice, avocado, and a side or salad topping.

name: Couscous with Carrot and Tomatoes
description: A flavorful couscous dish with fresh carrots and tomatoes.
instruction: Cook couscous and toss with sautéed carrots and tomatoes.

name: Chickpea Curry
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. Cook canned or pre-cooked chickpeas in olive oil, and spices like turmeric and garlic powder. Add the curry paste and coconut milk, let simmer for 5 minutes. Mix and serve.

name: Lentil Taco Bowl
instructions: Combine cooked tofu, black beans, corn, and sauteed vegetables in a bowl. Season with chili powder, lime juice, and salt. Serve warm or cold.

name: Veggie Tray Bake
instructions: Grill halved tomatoes in a pan. Cook couscous with boiling water and mix with chickpeas. Combine everything and season with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

name: Aubergine Stew with Rice
description: A flavorful aubergine stew served with rice.
instruction: Cook aubergines in a savory stew, then serve over rice.

name: Fried Fish with Potato
description: A crispy fried fish served with a side of potatoes.
instruction: Fry the fish until golden and serve with boiled or roasted potatoes.

name: Fried Cod with Rice
description: Golden fried cod served with steamed rice.
instruction: Fry cod fillets and serve with steamed rice and vegetables.

name: Salmon and Zucchini
description: A flavorful salmon fillet served with creamy mashed potatoes.
instruction: Pan-sear or bake salmon and serve with mashed potatoes.

name: Salmon with Boiled Potato
description: Healthy salmon paired with boiled potatoes.
instruction: Cook salmon and serve with boiled potatoes and a side salad.

name: Cod with Couscous
description: Light and flaky cod served with couscous.
instruction: Cook cod fillets and serve over couscous with vegetables.

name: Chili Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni. In another pan, brown ground beef, add spices and tomato sauce. Stir in cooked pasta and cheese until melted.

name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend frozen berries with yogurt and a splash of milk. Pour into a bowl and top with granola and fresh fruit.

name: Steel Cut Oats
instructions: Simmer steel cut oats in water or milk until tender. Stir in cinnamon and top with fruit or nuts.

name: Garlic Shrimp Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti. In a pan, sauté shrimp with garlic and olive oil. Toss shrimp with cooked spaghetti and parsley.

name: Beef Ramen
instructions: Cook ramen noodles. In a pan, sauté beef slices with soy sauce. Combine noodles, beef, broth, and vegetables.

name: Quesadillas
instructions: Fill tortillas with cheese and optional toppings. Fold and cook on a skillet until golden and melty.

name: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef with breadcrumbs and spices. Form meatballs and cook. Simmer in creamy gravy sauce.

name: Cowboy Soup
instructions: Brown beef, add beans, vegetables, tomatoes, and broth. Simmer until hearty and flavorful.

name: Grilled Cheese
instructions: Butter bread slices. Place cheese between slices and grill until golden brown and melty.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Whisk eggs and cheese. Toss hot pasta with egg mixture, crispy bacon, and pepper.

name: Lemon Vanilla Pudding
instructions: Whisk together milk, sugar, cornstarch, vanilla, and lemon zest. Cook until thickened. Chill before serving.

name: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Mash bananas and mix with eggs and flour. Cook on a skillet until golden on both sides.

name: Pizza Buns
instructions: Roll out dough, top with sauce, cheese, and toppings. Roll up, slice, and bake until golden.

name: Chicken Caesar Flatbreads
instructions: Grill chicken and slice. Spread Caesar dressing on flatbreads, top with chicken, lettuce, and parmesan.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Grill chicken breast and slice. Toss with mixed greens, tomatoes, cucumbers, and a light dressing.

name: Peanut Tofu Stirfry
instructions: Sauté tofu cubes until golden. Stir fry with vegetables and toss in a peanut sauce.

name: Falafel Nourish Bowl
instructions: Arrange cooked falafel, greens, veggies, and grains in a bowl. Drizzle with tahini sauce.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl
instructions: Cube fresh salmon and marinate briefly in soy sauce, sesame oil, and a touch of rice vinegar. Assemble a bowl with cooked rice, salmon, cucumber, avocado, and edamame. Top with sesame seeds and optional sriracha mayo.
